children: Fujitsu Limited (TSE:6702) is scaling up sovereign AI and global exports with its FUJITSU-MONAKA CPU and MONAKA Servers (availability from Nov 2026, broader 2027 shipments), shipping Fugaku-based chips abroad next year, expanding Palantir ties and live generative AI deployments while joining Japan-Netherlands quantum cooperation.
: Fujitsu (6702) to ship FUJITSU-MONAKA CPU and MONAKA Servers for sovereign AI: availability from Nov 2026, wider shipments in 2027. CPU 3.8GHz, 3D-stacked, improved AI throughput and efficiency.
: Fujitsu (6702) will export AI semiconductors based on Fugaku tech to the U.S. and Asia, with shipments expected to start as early as next year.
: Fujitsu (6702) expanded its Palantir deal: adopting Palantir AIP and Foundry, becoming a Global FDE partner, integrating its Takane LLM. A deployment saved $10M in a year and doubled productivity.
: Fujitsu (6702) deployed generative AI with Sony Bank for core banking development—transitioned from proof-of-concept to live operation in Sept 2025, running continuously through July 2026.
: Fujitsu Limited (6702) is part of Japan-Netherlands quantum tech cooperation, including joint research, talent exchanges, shared facilities and work on security-related applications.
